```{r cars}
dates <- readRDS("../data/dates.rds") %>% unique()
```




```{r}
#spread(dates,'Patient ID', key=Timepoint, value=Days)

```
```{r}

sublist <- dates %>% mutate(difference = irAE - Microbiome.days)

```

```{r}

ggplot(sublist, aes(x=difference)) + geom_histogram()



```
#adding timepoints

```{r}

#irae_day <- sublist %>% mutate(irae_samps = case_when(difference <=14 & 
                                                        #difference > -14  
                                                     #~ "1", TRUE ~ "0" )) 
irae_day <- sublist %>% mutate(irae_samps = case_when(difference == -4 ~ "timepoint1", difference == -5 ~ "timepoint2", difference == -6 | difference == 7 ~ "timepoint3", difference == 10 | difference == -8 | difference == -9 | difference == 9 ~ "timepoint4", difference == -11 | difference == 11 ~ "timepoint5", TRUE ~ "no timepoint"))
                    
iraes_days_times <- irae_day %>% mutate(time_windows = case_when(difference == -4 ~ "+/- 3 Day", difference == -5 ~ "+/- 5 Day", difference == -6 | difference == 7 ~ "+/- 7 Day", difference == 10 | difference == -8 | difference == -9 | difference == 9 ~ "+/- 10 Day", difference == -11 | difference == 11 ~ "+/- 14 Day", TRUE ~ "Out")) 
  

```

```{r}
ggplot(iraes_days_times, aes(x=time_windows, y= irae_samps, group=1)) + 
       geom_line(linetype = "dashed") + geom_point()

```
Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
